I’m running for Attorney General to defend Texas at a time when it’s under assault from Islamists, Marxists, dark money networks, and corporate board rooms.

Texas must lead the free world. I’ll leave it all on the field using every moment God has given me to protect this state and its future. Live Free.

Video

Great event with some Tea Party patriots in Montgomery County 🇺🇸

Proud to lay out my decades-long record fighting for limited government, fiscal sanity, and conservative principles #LiveFree

Birth tourism is an offense to our sovereignty and the Constitution.

It’s a logical absurdity to say if 20 million Chinese communists have 20 million babies here there are 20 million new US citizens.

End Birthright Citizenship. As AG I’ll attack from every angle.

Video

Texas needs an Attorney General who will crush any trace of Sharia law.

This is no place for ceremonial on-the-job training.

I’ve defended Texas in the courtroom, and I’ll be ready on Day One to keep fighting #LiveFree

Video

Texans don’t want the government tracking, monitoring, or controlling their vehicles - especially not with the ability to shut them down using a remote “kill switch.”

As Attorney General, I’ll keep fighting every day to protect your civil liberties, your privacy, and your right to be free from government overreach.
